The topic of **Clinical Indicator** in this corpus refers specifically to supplementary quality metrics used by the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] to evaluate 30-day mortality rates following acute surgery. To ensure fair and accurate quality assessments, these indicators stratify patients based on their baseline comorbidity burden.

Specifically, the database utilizes supplementary indicator 9a to track the proportion of patients who die within 30 days of their operation among those with a [[charlson-score-0|Charlson Score = 0]], which indicates no registered comorbidities [^src1]. Additionally, supplementary indicator 9b measures 30-day mortality for patients with a slightly higher comorbidity burden, specifically those with a [[charlson-score-1-2|Charlson Score = 1 eller 2]] [^src1]. This second indicator applies to all operated patients who possess the relevant diagnosis and procedure codes [^src1]. By separating these cohorts, the database can more accurately assess surgical outcomes and mortality risks relative to the patients' underlying health status.

## Claims

- Supplerende indikator til Indikator 9a beskriver andelen af patienter, der dør indenfor 30 dage fra tidspunkt for operation, for patienter med Charlson Score 0, svarende til ingen registreret komorbiditet [^src1] (akut-kirurgi-databasen, charlson-score-0)
